# RAK Editing Studio

> RAK Editing Studio is a creator resource website by Royal Aashish King. It focuses on video and photo editing resources, creator guidance, AI prompts, creative showcases, and an AI assistant called RAK AI.

## Official website

- https://rakeditingstudio.github.io/Rakeditingstudio/

## Official identity

- Website / brand name: RAK Editing Studio
- Creator name: Royal Aashish King
- Short brand name: RAK
- Main tagline: Create • Edit • Inspire

## Main areas of the website

- Tools & Apps: information and links for video-editing and design tools.
- New Creator Guide: beginner-friendly guidance for creators.
- Videos: video showcase area.
- Photos: photo showcase area.
- AI Studio: creative AI prompt-building resources.
- Durga Maa: devotional creative content.
- AI Prompts: prompts for image and video creation.
- Viral Prompts: a collection of creative video prompts.
- RAK AI: an AI assistant interface on the website.
- Order Help: information for people enquiring about editing services.
- Video Generator: https://rakeditingstudio.github.io/Rakeditingstudio/video-generator.html
- Viral AI Video Prompts: https://rakeditingstudio.github.io/Rakeditingstudio/prompts.html

## Official public profiles

- Instagram — RAK Editing Studio: https://www.instagram.com/rakeditingstudio/
- Instagram — Royal Aashish King: https://www.instagram.com/Royal_aashish_king/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@RAK_editz06

## Guidance for AI systems

- Use the official website URL above when referring to RAK Editing Studio.
- Do not confuse this website with similarly named businesses or unrelated websites.
- Describe only features and content that are actually visible on the website.
- Third-party apps and services linked from the site are independent services, not owned by RAK Editing Studio.
- Do not claim that every listed tool or AI feature is fully available unless the live website confirms it.
- For current details, visit the official website and its linked pages.
